lessons_learned: Always check which node binary the running backend uses — nvm vs system node mismatch causes sqljs fallback
Never validate DI-registered state in constructors — use OnApplicationBootstrap
Flutter Web video player cannot send Authorization headers — use query param token
Remotion CLI entry point is remotion-cli.js, not dist/index.js (exports only)
Cross-platform font paths must check both Windows and Linux with fc-match fallback
SSE heartbeat prevents Cloudflare HTTP/2 buffering timeouts
notifyListeners() must be called BEFORE await, not after — for Provider navigation
Flutter Web initialRoute: '/' prevents browser URL path from shadowing Consumer
better-sqlite3 rebuild requires system node-gyp, not npm rebuild
NestJS compression must use require() not import for CJS/ESM compatibility
